ArmDotConsole: a command line tool created to automate protecting assemblies and generating license keys.

Usage:

Shows this help:
ArmDotConsole --help

Obfuscates asemblies:
ArmDotConsole --input-assembly assembly1.dll --enable-obfuscate-names --input-assembly assembly2.dll --protect-embedded-resources

Builds specified project:
ArmDotConsole --build --project-path <project path>

Generates license key:
ArmDotConsole --generate-license-key --project-path <project path> --license-user-name <user name> --license-user-email <user email> [--license-expiration-date <expiration date>] [--license-maximum-build-date <maximum build date>] [--license-user-data-base64 <user data in base64 format>] [--license-user-hardware-id <hardware id>]

Generates a hardware id of the current machine:
ArmDotConsole --generate-hardware-id --hardware <hardware>

General

Option                            Description

--help                            Displays usage.

--license-file-path <license file path>
                                  If specified, a registered version of ArmDot reads a license key from the
                                  file <license file path>.

--arguments-file <path>           If specified, ArmDotConsole reads arguments from the file path <path>.
                                  Use this option when it's impossible to pass parameters in the usual way
                                  because the command line length reaches its maximum.

Obfuscation

Option                            Description

--input-assembly <assembly path>  If specified, ArmDotConsole obfuscates the assembly <assembly path>.

--output-assembly <assembly path> If specified, ArmDotConsole writes obfuscated assembly to assembly path.
                                  If --output-assembly is omitted, ArmDotConsole writes obfuscated
